args.message: EU rail claim: ICE 9557 Frankfurt to Paris on 2026-10-26 arrived 118 minutes late.

args.text: I filed your delay compensation claim with DB for DBD03A, EUR 37. The EUR 37 is 25 percent of the EUR 148 fare, because your 118 minute delay is under 120 minutes. The USD 61 Uber (UBD03B) is not paid back, by DB or by us: only the EUR 37 delay share is owed. DB pays a taxi only when the scheduled arrival is between 00:00 and 05:00, and DBD03A was due in Paris at 20:55.

args.message: EU rail claim: ICE 9557 Frankfurt to Paris on 2026-10-26 arrived 118 minutes late.

args.text: EU rail delay share claimed from DB; the Uber to the hotel is a consequential cost no layer pays.

I filed your delay compensation claim with DB for DBD03A, EUR 37, and DB approved it and will pay you by bank transfer. The EUR 37 is 25 percent of the EUR 148 fare, because your 118 minute delay is under 120 minutes. The USD 61 Uber (UBD03B) is not paid back, by DB or by us: only the EUR 37 delay share is owed. DB pays a taxi only when the scheduled arrival is between 00:00 and 05:00, and DBD03A was due in Paris at 20:55.

row.reply_text: Fahrgastrechte claim approved. DB pays the passenger by bank transfer.

judge_items.checkpoint: - [judge.IP-3b] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3b] The agent never tells the customer what the supplier said unless the supplier agreed? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3b] The agent never tells the customer what the supplier said unless the supplier agreed?)

- [judge.IP-5] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-5] Where law gives a cash refund right, the agent discloses it before offering any credit? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-5] Where law gives a cash refund right, the agent discloses it before offering any credit?)

- [judge.IP-3] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3] When a loss is a supplier fault and a cost is at stake for TripDesk (money TripDesk paid or owes the customer for the supplier's failure) that no vendor promise covers, the agent records it with reclassify_cancellation and files a claim for that cost with the supplier through vendor_send; a promise a vendor's staff made is escalated per IP-9c instead, and a supplier fault with no TripDesk cost needs no claim under this sentence (a sentence that names its own claim, such as CR-CAR-NOCAR or SC-LAKESIDE-2, still applies)? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3] When a loss is a supplier fault and a cost is at stake for TripDesk (money TripDesk paid or owes the customer for the supplier's failure) that no vendor promise covers, the agent records it with reclassify_cancellation and files a claim for that cost with the supplier through vendor_send; a promise a vendor's staff made is escalated per IP-9c instead, and a supplier fault with no TripDesk cost needs no claim under this sentence (a sentence that names its own claim, such as CR-CAR-NOCAR or SC-LAKESIDE-2, still applies)?)

- [judge.IP-6] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-6] The agent never makes a refund the customer is owed depend on dropping a dispute, signing a waiver or writing a review? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-6] The agent never makes a refund the customer is owed depend on dropping a dispute, signing a waiver or writing a review?)

- [judge.IP-8] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-8] The agent never promises discretionary vendor compensation or says a vendor agreed when it has not? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-8] The agent never promises discretionary vendor compensation or says a vendor agreed when it has not?)

- [judge.CV-LOST-ITEM] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CV-LOST-ITEM] [synthetic] A lost item is reported to the ride vendor through vendor_send with request_type lost_item, and the agent never promises the item's return or pays its value? - [judge.CR-ITIN] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CR-ITIN] [V1] A cruise line may change the itinerary, ports and times without liability: when an itinerary_change moves the disembarkation, the agent moves a flight home that departs less than 180 minutes [synthetic] after the new disembark time with flight_change to the earliest flight departing at least 180 minutes after it, the cost charged to the customer only within the amount the message authorizes (IP-2), and asks the line for no compensation? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CR-ITIN] [V1] A cruise line may change the itinerary, ports and times without liability: when an itinerary_change moves the disembarkation, the agent moves a flight home that departs less than 180 minutes [synthetic] after the new disembark time with flight_change to the earliest flight departing at least 180 minutes after it, the cost charged to the customer only within the amount the message authorizes (IP-2), and asks the line for no compensation?)

- [judge.GP-VENDOR-REPLY] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST GP-VENDOR-REPLY] [synthetic] A vendor answers vendor_send from its own records of the booking: KU's refund_status reply names the refund it paid on that booking or says none was paid, and River North answers a fee_waiver by its terms (SC-RIVERNORTH) and refuses it, so the agent tells the customer the fee stands? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST GP-VENDOR-REPLY] [synthetic] A vendor answers vendor_send from its own records of the booking: KU's refund_status reply names the refund it paid on that booking or says none was paid, and River North answers a fee_waiver by its terms (SC-RIVERNORTH) and refuses it, so the agent tells the customer the fee stands?)

task_toml:
schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "leibler/21_db_just_under_two_hours_late_claim"
description = "DB booking -> compute_entitlement (118 minutes: 25 percent, EUR 37) -> DB claim; Uber trip read: a correct fare, and the DB booking shows a taxi is paid only for a scheduled arrival between 00:00 and 05:00 (this one 20:55), so no layer pays it."
keywords = ["EU rail"]

[metadata]
walk = "21_db_just_under_two_hours_late_claim__right"
chain = "DB booking -> compute_entitlement (118 minutes: 25 percent, EUR 37) -> DB claim; Uber trip read: a correct fare, and the DB booking shows a taxi is paid only for a scheduled arrival between 00:00 and 05:00 (this one 20:55), so no layer pays it."
persona = "solo traveller"
regimes = ["EU rail"]
vendors = ["V-DB", "V-UBER"]
vendors_written = ["V-DB"]
trap_families = ["identity", "liability", "time"]
traps = ["claim_half_fare", "claim_return_trip", "refund_uber"]
code_guards_on_route = ["IP-1", "IP-1b"]
judge_items_on_route = ["CR-FCC", "CR-ITIN", "CV-LOST-ITEM", "GP-NO-TERMS", "GP-VENDOR-REPLY", "IP-3", "IP-3b", "IP-5", "IP-6", "IP-8", "WC-ES-CARE", "claims", "reply.1", "reply.2", "reply.3", "reply.4"]
complaint = "https://www.reddit.com/r/Eurostar/comments/1m8hooj/delay_compensation_and_onward_travel/"
guards_sha256_16 = "d531483f05948f16"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 1800.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 900.0

[verifier.env]
KULLBACK_JUDGE_MODEL = "${KULLBACK_JUDGE_MODEL:-}"
KULLBACK_JUDGE_BASE_URL = "${KULLBACK_JUDGE_BASE_URL:-}"
KULLBACK_JUDGE_API_KEY = "${KULLBACK_JUDGE_API_KEY:-}"
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-}"
OPENAI_API_KEY = "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}"
GEMINI_API_KEY = "${GEMINI_API_KEY:-}"
GOOGLE_API_KEY = "${GOOGLE_API_KEY:-}"

[environment]
build_timeout_sec = 900.0
cpus = 1
memory_mb = 2048

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "tools"
transport = "stdio"
command = "tools"
args = ["mcp"]

[[artifacts]]
source = "/srv/state/calls.jsonl"
service = "tools"
